newsitem.title: USA: U S West Media Group Q2 loss narrows.
newsitem.headline: U S West Media Group Q2 loss narrows.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
Q2 net results before preferred div $12 million vs $13 million.
Q2 EBITDA -- earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization -- $657 million vs $566 million.

Pro forma results reflect Continental Cablevision merger, Continental acquisition of remaining interest in Meredith/New Heritage Strategic, and reclassification of Teleport Communications investment to equity method.
Yr-ago avg shrs include 150.6 million shrs from Continental merger.
Q2 MediaOne U.S. cable subs 5.1 million, up 3.4 pct.
Q2 U.S. wireless cellular subs 2.1 million, up 33.1 pct.
U S West Media is 100 percent owned by U S West Inc, which also owns U S West Communications Group.
